claims.claim: Browser developer tools include an Inspector for exploring the DOM and editing CSS, a JavaScript debugger, and a JavaScript console.
The Inspector can expose the document structure and styles currently applied to a selected element.
The console object provides access to a debugging console, while details of console APIs can differ by runtime.
A browser network monitor records requests and provides request details and a request list for inspection.
A JavaScript debugger can pause execution and let a developer inspect values and control execution.
Temporary edits in developer tools are observations and experiments on the live page, not automatically edits to the project source files.
